mods.name: Render 1080p (dynamic-resolution index locked at 15 = 1920x1080, also in cutscenes)
mods.title: Render at 1080p
mods.description: The game renders at 1920x1080, also in cutscenes, where it would go up to 3584x2016.

mods.name: Game speed: real time down to 8 fps (game clock step cap 1/15 s -> 1/8 s)
mods.title: Real game speed down to 8 fps
mods.gain: no fps gain; the game no longer slows down between 8 and 15 fps
mods.description: Below 15 fps the game runs in slow motion (at 10 fps two thirds of real speed). With this it keeps real speed down to 8 fps; motion jumps in bigger steps, physics may misbehave.
